title: Intel 12th Generation Core i5-12400 Alder Lake Processor

items.h: Clock Speed: 2.50 GHz Up to 4.40 GHz

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Intel 12th Gen Core i5-12400 Processor | Alder Lake | 6 Cores, 12 Threads | Desktop CPU

Upgrade your PC with the Intel Core i5-12400 12th Generation Alder Lake Processor  for exceptional performance and efficiency. Built on Intel’s advanced Alder Lake architecture, this powerful 6-core, 12-thread CPU delivers smooth multitasking, faster gaming, and superior productivity. With a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz and a Turbo Boost up to 4.4 GHz, the i5-12400 offers outstanding performance for modern applications.

The Intel 12th Generation Core i5-12400 Alder Lake Processor is one of the most popular mid-range CPUs, offering exceptional performance for gaming, content creation, and daily multitasking. Built on Intel’s revolutionary Alder Lake hybrid architecture, the i5-12400 features 6 high-performance “P-cores” and 12 threads, delivering smooth performance across demanding applications and gaming titles.


With a base clock of 2.5GHz and a turbo boost up to 4.4GHz, this CPU ensures fast responsiveness and stable productivity. It comes with 18MB Intel Smart Cache for optimized data access and ultra-low latency. Compatible with both DDR4-3200 and DDR5-4800 memory, the i5-12400 provides outstanding flexibility for budget-friendly and next-gen builds.


Thanks to PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 support, users can enjoy high-speed storage and GPU performance. The included Intel Laminar RM1 cooler allows efficient cooling with quiet performance, making it excellent for non-overclocked builds. With a power-efficient 65W TDP, the processor suits both compact and full-size gaming setups.


Whether you're upgrading your PC or building a new budget-to-mid gaming rig, the Intel Core i5-12400 offers one of the best price-to-performance ratios in Bangladesh.
